## Prices (USD)
- Essential $70 then $20/year; Self-Managed $120 then $25/year; Signature $180 then $30/year. Deposit $50. Stay Visible $15/month. Same in every country. Payment: PayNow (EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, ZimSwitch, cards) in Zimbabwe; PayPal (any card or PayPal balance) or USDT on BNB Smart Chain anywhere.
